surface_verification.justification: This is a server-only, no-client-delta iterate (the client Org page is a separate, explicitly out-of-scope item), so 'web' is not the right surface — the real runtime surface is the new Hono route family itself, unreachable from the existing unit suite's mocked-fs style. Verified with real HTTP requests against a live Hono server (npx tsx src/index.ts, PORT=3849) bound to the machine's actual resolved host (this shell has SHIPWRIGHT_NETWORK_PROFILE=tailscale set ambiently, so the probe incidentally ran against the real Tailscale-range host branch rather than only loopback): secret gate (no header -> 401, wrong header -> 401), GET org-chart -> 200 with the seeded lead in the body, GET usage (unmeasured) -> 200, PUT on a missing LOCKED_KINDS file -> 404 (the external-review auto-vivify fix, proven against the real filesystem, not a mock), and a full POST countersign round trip -> 200 with ADR-0001 both in the response body and written to decision_log.md on disk. Script: f05-api-probe.sh (self-contained, trap-cleanup on exit). See surface_verification.log for the raw PASS lines.
